title: THE MIRROR AND THE LITTLE BOY
passages: I explained that social media was a mirror pointed at myself. My everyday life still contained work, analysis, and ordinary routines. The creative space let me explore how I moved, what I valued, and who I was becoming.

Then I wrote about becoming a parent at seventeen, marriage, divorce, heartbreak, and transformation. Underneath those chapters, I could still recognize the little boy who wanted to run toward whatever made him feel alive. I wanted to make a life he would recognize with pride.

reflections.prompt: What would your younger self recognize in you?
Think about something you loved as a child. Where does that interest still appear in your life today?
Make a little room this week for that childhood interest, in a form that fits your life now.
